scientific_intervention: Inherited ha/hb generator forms; only two sex-specific location parameters change per calibrated version
age_recipe: Each integer age in each ten-year bin occurs the published baseline bin count times; source total is baseline n4420 multiplied by10. Last open >=70 bin is compressed to70-79 for task support, not a claim of source maximum. Within-bin uniform ages assumed.
bmi_sex_distribution: Same pooled marginal within both sexes because raw sex-specific quantiles unknown

scenarios.description: Source sex-age bins; pooled quartile-matched BMI; independent within-sex age and BMI
Same margins; assumed moderate positive Gaussian-copula dependence
Same dependence ranks as alt1; log-BMI tail sensitivity with identical published quartile anchors

copula_recipe: Within sex use ascending row ranks over the fixed age lattice as latent Gaussian age quantiles. Use one fixed independent normal vector per sex. Rank rho*z_age+sqrt(1-rho^2)*z_noise and assign exactly stratified BMI quantiles (rank+0.5)/n; same latent ranks for alt1/alt2. Integer ages introduce ties; reported correlation is diagnostic, rho is latent not Pearson age-BMI correlation.
bmi_quantile_recipe: Normal family:27.5+s_side*Phi^-1(u), s_left=(27.5-24.5)/Phi^-1(.75),s_right=(31-27.5)/Phi^-1(.75). Log family:27.5*exp(t_side*Phi^-1(u)),t_left=log(27.5/24.5)/Phi^-1(.75),t_right=log(31/27.5)/Phi^-1(.75). Clip to15-50; unknown tails are assumed.

calibration.estimator: Pool verified initial generated rows over all3source seeds within sex/context; type7 median, not average of seed medians
calibration.ha_requirement: Central pooled order statistics must both lie strictly inside3-20 before translating location

evidence_roles.masuch2019: HbA1c medians/quartiles, age slopes, pooled age/BMI quartiles
evidence_roles.volzke2015: Raw sex-age-bin counts; weighted BMI not used
evidence_roles.grossmann2024: Context-only overlapping-cohort age/BMI means/SD; diagnostic cross-check, no fitting

unassessed: Actual within-bin ages and >79 attained-age distribution
